systems.country_label: délivrance en ligne du casier judiciaire
systems.owner: Ministère de la Justice et des Droits de l'Homme, built with the digital economy ministry through AGETIC
systems.tiers: Online for citizens across the national territory and the diaspora, processed centrally; official test on 10 February 2026

note: A public portal for criminal record extracts (and a second for nationality certificates) run by the justice ministry; not a station record system, and nothing is said on police or gendarmerie stations.
